name: ReactomeInteractors_get_protein_interactors
description: Get protein-protein interaction partners from Reactome's IntAct-derived data. Returns the authoritative total plus a pageable set of interactors; when has_more is true pass next_page as page with the same accession and page_size. Interactions include confidence scores and evidence counts.

accession.description: UniProt accession number for the query protein. Examples: 'P04637' (TP53), 'Q04206' (NF-kB p65), 'P00533' (EGFR), 'P38398' (BRCA1).

page_size.description: Maximum number of interactors to return on this page (default: 20). Not capped - pass a value >= total_interactors (e.g. 300 for P04637) to retrieve every interactor in one call.

page.description: One-based Reactome interactor page. Continue with next_page while has_more is true.

total_interactors.description: True total number of known interactors for this protein (from Reactome's interactors summary endpoint), independent of page_size. Falls back to the number returned on this page when the summary endpoint is unavailable, in which case total_is_exact is false.

total_is_exact.description: True when total_interactors is the authoritative total; false when it is only the count returned on this page

returned_interactors.description: Number of interactors actually returned in this response

truncated.description: True when returned_interactors is less than total_interactors, i.e. page_size cut off the result set

has_more.description: Whether a later interactor page is available

next_page.description: Next one-based page, or null when complete

note.description: Human-readable explanation present when results were truncated or the true total could not be determined

score.description: Interaction confidence score (0-1, higher = more confident)

evidences.description: Number of experimental evidences supporting this interaction

name: ReactomeInteractors_get_entity_pathways
description: Find Reactome biological pathways that contain a specific molecular entity. Returns pathway stable IDs, names, and whether they are disease-associated. Use Reactome stable IDs (e.g., R-HSA-199420 for PTEN) obtained from ReactomeInteractors_search_entity. Example: R-HSA-199420 (PTEN) participates in 10 pathways including PI3K/AKT signaling, PTEN regulation, and TCR signaling.

entity_id.description: Reactome stable identifier for the entity. Use ReactomeInteractors_search_entity to find IDs. Examples: 'R-HSA-199420' (PTEN), 'R-HSA-69541' (TP53 tetramer), 'R-HSA-8869337' (TP53).

species.description: NCBI taxonomy ID for species filter (default: 9606 for human). Examples: 9606 (human), 10090 (mouse).

has_diagram.description: Whether pathway has a diagram available

name: ReactomeInteractors_search_entity
description: Search and page through Reactome biological entities by name or identifier. Reactome groups results by entity type and applies limit/offset independently inside every group: limit=2 can therefore return up to two Proteins, two Complexes, two Pathways, etc., not two records globally. Metadata reports aggregate numberOfMatches, actual returned count, per-group totals, rows_per_group, and next_offset.

query.description: Search query - gene name, protein name, pathway name, or Reactome ID. Examples: 'TP53', 'BRCA1', 'apoptosis', 'insulin signaling', 'cell cycle'.

species.description: Species name filter (default: 'Homo sapiens'). Examples: 'Homo sapiens', 'Mus musculus', 'Rattus norvegicus'.

types.description: Entity type filter. Options: 'Protein', 'Complex', 'Reaction', 'Pathway', 'SmallMolecule'. If null, returns all types.

limit.description: Rows to request per Reactome result-type group, not a global response maximum.

offset.description: Zero-based start row applied independently within every result-type group. Continue with metadata.next_offset.

type.description: Entity type: Protein, Complex, Reaction, Pathway, etc.
